verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a payments platform that ships SDKs and dashboards, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents a telemetry or tracking opt-out: the docs cover payments, issuing and card controls, and the community items about the data breach do not address telemetry, so they are ignored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
